title: Michu Mizan
description: Led frontend development for Ethiopia's first interest-free (Shariah-compliant) digital financing platform, now used to disburse ETB 60M+ to 1,500+ customers.

caseStudy.role: Frontend lead · Cooperative Bank of Oromia (DxValley)
caseStudy.context: Ethiopia had no interest-free digital financing. Michu Mizan is the country's first Shariah-compliant lending platform, built inside the bank's digital innovation arm.
work: Led frontend development for the platform's customer-facing web app.
Built it in Next.js and TypeScript, with Tailwind for the UI and Framer Motion for interaction.
caseStudy.outcome: Now used to disburse ETB 60M+ in capital to 1,500+ customers.

title: Souqpass
description: Co-built the frontend, in a two-engineer team, for Ethiopia's first revenue-based financing platform: ETB 150M+ funded to 3,000+ small businesses.

caseStudy.context: Small businesses in Ethiopia had no revenue-based financing. Souqpass is the country's first platform for it.
work: Co-built the frontend with one other engineer.
React with Redux for state and Tailwind for the UI.
caseStudy.outcome: ETB 150M+ funded to 3,000+ small businesses. It is now the primary financing tool for the country's agricultural sector.

title: Zakat & Awqaf Platform
description: Ethiopia's national zakat and waqf platform, built with the Zakat and Awqaf Commission. I build the donor flows and the multi-level admin console, plus the CI/CD pipeline that deploys it to VMs.

caseStudy.role: Frontend and CI/CD · built with the Zakat and Awqaf Commission
caseStudy.context: Ethiopia's national platform for zakat and waqf: donors calculate and pay zakat, and the commission manages funds and assets.
work: The multi-level admin console the commission runs on.
The CI/CD pipeline that deploys the platform to Linux VMs.
caseStudy.outcome: Live at ezaac.com as the commission's national platform.

title: CoopScale HR Platform
description: Deployment and platform work for Cooperative Bank of Oromia's HR system: Kubernetes in production, CI/CD pipelines built from scratch, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on a self-managed server.

caseStudy.context: The bank's HR system needed a production platform and a build pipeline, on a free GitHub organisation with private repositories.
work: Run the system on Kubernetes in production.
Built the CI/CD pipelines from scratch.
Set up self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on a self-managed server.
caseStudy.outcome: Private-repository builds and tests keep running on a free GitHub organisation.

title: Fleet OS
description: Multi-tenant platform for independent taxi fleets, built end to end: tenant-scoped database schema, APIs, and role-based auth behind dashboards for leased-vehicle management, driver assignment, and routing. VK Tech.

caseStudy.role: Built end to end · VK Tech (contract)
caseStudy.context: Independent taxi fleets need one platform to manage leased vehicles, drivers and routes, with each fleet's data kept apart.
work: Dashboards for leased-vehicle management, driver assignment and routing.
caseStudy.outcome: One multi-tenant platform serves many independent fleets.

title: Charge Hub
description: Operator console for a B2B EV charging platform. Real-time charger control over unreliable networks, using confirmation-gated UI state and idempotent commands to stop double-triggered chargers and billing drift. VK Tech.

caseStudy.context: Operators of a B2B EV charging platform control chargers in real time, over networks that drop and retry.
work: Confirmation-gated UI state: the console shows a charger as changed only once the charger confirms it.
Idempotent commands, so a retried request cannot trigger a charger twice.
caseStudy.outcome: Stopped double-triggered chargers and the billing drift they caused.

title: AIGC API
description: Centralised backend service that handles and standardises AI image and video generation requests across the VK Tech product suite, replacing per-product integrations.

caseStudy.context: Each product in the suite integrated AI image and video generation separately.
work: Built a central backend service that takes generation requests from every product.
Standardised how requests are handled across providers and products.
caseStudy.outcome: Replaced the per-product integrations with one service.
